collaboration.title: Upgrade this canvas?
collaboration.description: Enable concurrent property and text editing. The canvas identity and saved versions stay the same. Other open editors must reload; ask collaborators to finish syncing their changes first.
collaboration.failed: The upgrade failed. Reload the canvas and retry after all edits have synced.
conversion.title: Convert canvas to a new artifact
conversion.description: The canvas text becomes an editable workbook or document. Later canvas changes leave your edits in the generated artifact intact.
conversion.failed: Unable to complete the action. Reopen the current Canvas and retry.
conversion.updatedDescription: Review the new Canvas revision and create an updated copy. The previous result and all manual edits are preserved.
